about: 270 billable ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes about the ankle and foot, with their official descriptions, copied from CMS's 2027 code descriptions in tabular order (icd10cm_codes_2027.txt, in effect 1 Oct 2026 to 30 Sep 2027). Selection: S82.5 and S82.6 (initial encounter, closed fracture only), S90.0, S92.00, S93.0, S93.4, S96.01, S96.11, S96.81, S96.91, M25.37, M25.47, M25.57, M25.67, M84.37, M84.47. Used by the commons page's keyword illustration; ICD-10-CM is a US government work.
